title: Buttery Crumble Almond Crisp
description: A sweet and crunchy dessert topped with a buttery crumble and crunchy almonds.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together flour, sugar, and cold butter until crumbly.
Add in almonds and mix until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and press down evenly.
Top with juicy fruit and crumble mixture.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until the topping is golden brown and the fruit is tender.
Remove from oven and let cool for a few minutes.
Note: If using a different type of fruit, adjust the baking time accordingly.
